operating_profit: not printed (the managing company prints only profit before tax per segment); the deck definition (management fees less S&M less G&A) must be computed downstream.

members for the investment/other metrics of the dormant-accounts and direct-expense tables: printed but outside the v7 metric list; pension payments to pensioners and actuarial surplus rows likewise not recorded.
notes: Source: the managing company's own periodic report on MAYA (reporter: מור גמל ופנסיה בע"מ, tax id 514956465): directors' report + financial statements (+ description of the business in annual reports). The listed parent (מור השקעות) was not used.

Amounts in NIS thousands as printed unless the fact says otherwise (the AUM-by-segment table prints NIS millions); members = count; fee rates = percent as printed. Negative values printed in parentheses are kept negative; a dash is recorded as value null with a note.

Per-fund-type table (directors' report in quarterly reports; description of the business in annual reports): column identity checked against the printed header (x-position of header words). Columns: total (provident + new pensions), child-savings investment gemel (קופת גמל להשקעה לחסכון ארוך טווח לילד), investment gemel (קופת גמל להשקעה), study fund (קרן השתלמות), provident savings/compensation (קופת גמל לחיסכון, תגמולים ופיצויים), general new pension (קרן פנסיה כללית), comprehensive new pension (קרן פנסיה מקיפה). segment provident = the four gemel columns (each its own fact with fund_type), pension_new = the two pension columns, total = the printed total column. No cross-column aggregate was calculated. Every additive row was checked: the total column equals the sum of the fund-type columns.

Flow windows are cumulative from 1 January as printed: q in Q1 reports, ytd (six / nine months) in Q2/Q3 reports, fy in annual reports and for the year-end comparative table. The Q2 and Q3 reports print no stand-alone three-month fund-type table; three-month P&L figures are printed in the directors' report P&L table and in the segment note.

deposits = תקבולים מדמי גמולים and one_time_deposits = תקבולים מדמי גמולים חד פעמיים are two printed rows; the report does not state whether the one-time row is included in the first row, so no relation is assumed.

Management fees from assets are printed for active+inactive accounts and, separately, for pension recipients (מקבלי קצבה); both are recorded with sub. The pension fee rate on assets is printed per population (active, inactive, recipients).

Segment note (ביאור 3, מגזרי פעילות): provident = מגזר גמל, pension = מגזר פנסיה (new pension funds only; Mor manages no veteran pension funds), total = whole company; the column 'לא מיוחס למגזרי פעילות' (investment income and small unallocated expenses) is not recorded as a segment but is included in the total column. General and administrative expenses in the financial statements include the payment to the operator (אפ.אמ.אר, 'תשלום לגורם מתפעל'); the description of the business prints it as a separate line (operator_fees).

selling_and_marketing_expenses = 'עמלות, הוצאות שיווק ורכישה' as printed: current agent commissions plus amortisation of deferred acquisition costs (dac_amortisation is printed separately in the annual segment note only).
